name: labtrack
description: LabTrack - Sistema de Gestión de Préstamos de Laboratorios Universitarios (monorepo)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.e2e: npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run e2e -w qa && npm run db:seed -w backend
